calls.title: Webinar Debrief
calls.summary: The team reflected on a successful webinar characterized by strong participant interaction and effective Q&A management. They decided to switch exclusively to Zoom's Q&A features for streamlined engagement, as suggested by Ronny Kohavi. Challenges included ensuring co-host access for better chat control and addressing fairness issues in raffle selection, which relied on manual scrolling. They agreed on a structured follow-up plan for notifying raffle winners and improving participant communication. Additionally, the team identified operational enhancements, including thorough pre-webinar testing and better tracking of raffle entries, to ensure more reliable and equitable participant experiences in future webinars.
calls.keywords: webinar, Q&A management, raffle system, Zoom features, AB testing, product teams
